conclusion: The C=8 direct-conv chunkwise/WY candidate passes its CPU/primitive/resource gates and reduces the synthetic 30-layer 512-token GDN stage to 47.491 ms, but fails the frozen clean semantic, exact-trajectory, and two-shape speed contract. Clean teacher-forced KL reaches 0.056522 > 0.05, top-1 is 445/450 = 98.889% < 99%, and only 5/18 free-running 128-transition trajectories remain exact. Clean prefill reaches 2003.399 tok/s at 512 and 2280.244 tok/s at 4K, so 512 remains 16.951% below the 2412.320 llama.cpp HIP floor even though 4K is 1.116% above its floor. All HIP kernels, wrappers, registry entries, runtime selectors, and candidate-specific tests were removed; the CPU algebra oracle remains as rejected-design evidence and chain_lds32_direct remains production default.
